item.title: Hormel Foods Names Donald Monk as First CTO
item.description: Monk brings more than 35 years of global technology leadership to Hormel Foods, including 33 years at General Mills, where he ultimately served as chief information officer.

item.title: ISA Publishes New Standard for SCADA Systems
item.description: The ISA-112 Part 1 standard provides a vendor-neutral and technology-independent framework for the long-term management of SCADA systems and execution of SCADA modernization projects.

item.title: Litehouse Inc. Rebrands as Litehouse Foods
item.description: The company has unveiled a refreshed vision and values that brings its full portfolio of brands together, including Litehouse, Organicville, Veggiecraft, Sky Valley and partnered licensed brands including Flavortown, and Zaxbys.

item.title: Nulogy Debuts Manufacturing Operating System
item.description: With Nulogy MOS, manufacturers, contract packagers and 3PLs can manage production, quality, compliance and collaboration within one system.

item.title: Daikin Introduces R-290 Industrial Heat Pumps Up to 2,000 KW
item.description: The new platform is structured into two complementary ranges: EWA/YK-CZ monobloc units, from 20 to 85 kW, and EWYK-QZ modular heat pumps, configurable in multi-array systems up to 2,000 kW.

item.title: How Can Data Integration Support AI Adoption in CPG Manufacturing?
item.description: AI is revolutionizing manufacturing with applications in predictive analytics and product development. Despite challenges like data silos and integration, progress is being made towards agentic AI. Discover how companies are adapting and what the future may hold.

item.title: B&G Foods Sells U.S. Green Giant Frozen Vegetable Product Line to Seneca Foods
item.description: B&G Foods previously sold the Green Giant U.S. shelf-stable vegetable product line to Seneca Foods in November 2023 and the Le Sueur U.S. shelf-stable vegetable product line to McCall Farms in August 2025.

item.title: Hain Celestial Sells NA Snacks Business to Canadian Snack Manufacturer
item.description: Hain Celestial says the divestiture sharpens the company’s focus and advances a simplified North American portfolio centered on core categories with stronger margin and cash flow profiles.

item.title: Kirin Launches Two RTD Cocktails in U.S.
item.description: Created with American consumers in mind, the new flavors bring Hyoketsu’s signature crisp, fruit-forward taste to two key U.S. markets.

item.title: How Continuous Mixing Supports Efficient and Sustainable Baked Good Production
item.description: Thefirst continuous mixing systems were designed for low-volume production of stiffer doughs and products such as pretzels, crackers and bagels. But in the 30-plus years since, several kinds of continuous mixers have emerged to handle many distinct application challenges and all dough types.
